name: A Lesson in Divinity
summary: Danitha Morr asks you to show what a priest can do with the Symbol of Life. Deathguard Billmuth at Bandarion Keep has come seeking aid for a friend.

sections.title: A Plea for Aid
sections.body: Billmuth says the priests turned him away, and his friend may have no one else to help. He is not proud to ask you, but he needs aid for the Forsaken. The Symbol of Life is meant to help you demonstrate your ability to channel the Light, though handling it may cause discomfort. Its power is an ally and guide, even to the Forsaken, whose creation is tied to a force opposed to it.

faq.answer: Deathguard Billmuth at Bandarion Keep has come seeking help for a friend.

faq.q: Why does Billmuth ask a priest?
faq.answer: Billmuth says the priests turned him away, and you may be his friend's only chance.

faq.q: What is the Symbol of Life?
faq.answer: It is a talisman of the Light that Danitha Morr gives you to demonstrate your ability to channel the Light.

faq.q: Why might the Symbol of Life hurt to handle?
faq.answer: Danitha warns that the talisman may cause discomfort because the Light is opposed to the force that created the Forsaken.

faq.q: Where can I find Deathguard Billmuth?
faq.answer: Deathguard Billmuth is downstairs at Bandarion Keep.

angles.text: As a priest, Danitha asks you to demonstrate your ability to channel the Light with the Symbol of Life.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Lesson in Divinity
